instance.description: The instance whose implementation changed. Its name and every wire it sits on are unchanged — that is what makes this a replacement rather than a removal followed by an install.

from.description: The component that was behind it

to.description: The component behind it now. May be the same as `from` when only the configuration changed.

config.description: The configuration the new one was built with. Recorded because the same component with different config is a different thing to talk to, and reading the ledger later must not require guessing which.
